title: one cta per screen
rule: One Call to Action per screen — CTA usually appears alone, command-like (landing/welcome); may be as wide as its parent. Distinct from one-primary-in-a-group.
pass_when: Landing/welcome (command-like) screen has one CTA, usually alone; may span its parent.
fail_when: Multiple CTAs on that landing/welcome screen.
overview: Landing and welcome screens carry one command-like Call to Action.
apply_when: Composing a landing or welcome screen with a main command CTA.
not_when: In-app button groups — that is one-primary-per-group, not screen CTA.
agent_hint: Give landing/welcome screens one CTA alone; do not stack several CTAs.
description: Ant’s one Call to Action per screen is for command-like landing or welcome surfaces: the CTA usually appears alone and may span its parent width. It is distinct from limiting Primary inside a button group elsewhere in the product. Use it when composing that landing or welcome command, not ordinary multi-action toolbars. Fail multiple competing CTAs on that landing or welcome screen.
do_not_claim: One invented global cap vs group / page / section; `actions.buttons.one_primary` as a delete of this named CTA-per-screen row.
